chunks: And when I have made him and have breathed into him of My spirit. Fall down in homage before him.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God breathed His spirit into Adam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual nature of Adam’s creation, where the physical form was perfected before the divine spirit (Ruh) was breathed in, establishing his status as the vicegerent (Khalifah) of God. The command for angels to prostrate is interpreted not merely as worship but as a sign of honor and recognition of Adam’s superior spiritual station, a concept foundational to the Shia understanding of Imamate and the hierarchy of creation.
